title: 2026 Crux FACT 10r frameset
notes: Exact 2026 frameset page specifies FACT 10r carbon, Rider First Engineering, threaded bottom bracket, UDH, S-Works FACT carbon fork, 47C clearance and a 1.4 kg painted size-56 package. It describes responsive, reactive and supple ride intent but publishes no stiffness measurement.
